fairnessBoundary.labels: offline rendered-frame review plus official post-game damage provenance

reviewPolicy.visibleLiveBot: a mobile humanoid opponent is visibly identifiable in the rendered context around the proposal
reviewPolicy.hardNegative: the proposal is static world geometry, a pole/sign/flag/truck edge, a practice contact, or is spatially misaligned with the visible bot body
reviewPolicy.ambiguousReject: the rendered pixels are too small or occluded to establish identity
